prompt:
A long benchmark writes each completed row to disk so an interrupted run can resume. On resume it keeps every row already present except those marked `incomplete`, and re-runs only the missing cells.

Rows can also carry the status `auth_failure`, recorded when the provider refused the call because a rate limit was hit. Four such rows sit in the artifact from a run that hit a quota mid-way.

Decide whether resuming will produce a correct final artifact.

Verdict convention: answer `pass` if the thing described is sound as it stands, and `fail` if it is defective. The verdict describes the thing under review, never any proposal mentioned about it.
